 Nations League: David Badia expects a tough match, but remains optimistic
 The national coach of the Grenadiers, David Badia, during a press conference this Friday, November 13, stated that he expects a difficult match against the USA, but promises that the Grenadiers will not step onto the field of the Nu Stadium in Florida this Saturday, November 14 at 4:30 AM (Port-au-Prince time) as sacrificial lambs for this first leg of the Concacaf Nations League quarter-final.
